description: Manage logical APT repository state while preserving existing source and keyring formats

name.title: Repository name
name.description: Management label and filename stem for new files only. Existing repositories are discovered by URI and suite.

ensure.title: Ensure repository
ensure.description: Whether the logical binary-package repository definition should exist. Removal retains keyrings and unrelated entries.

uri.title: Repository URI
uri.description: Absolute HTTP, HTTPS, or local file URI for the APT repository.

suite.title: Repository suite
suite.description: APT distribution suite, such as trixie or stable.

components.title: Repository components
components.description: APT components provided by the repository.

architectures.title: Repository architectures
architectures.description: Architecture restrictions. Omission means APT host defaults, not any explicit architecture list.

signingKey.title: Repository signing key
signingKey.description: Complete inline ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key. Compared against existing explicit trust material; only new repositories require a managed binary keyring.

enabled.title: Repository enabled
enabled.description: Whether APT should use this repository. Disabled definitions still exist and remain discoverable.

_inDesiredState.title: Instance is in the desired state
_inDesiredState.description: Read-only result of the resource's Test operation.
